issues.explanation: Function 'withdrawAll' uses 'tx.origin' for authorization at line 13. A malicious contract can call this function on behalf of a legitimate user — 'tx.origin' will still be the user's address, bypassing the check and giving the attacker full access.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace 'tx.origin' with 'msg.sender' in function 'withdrawAll'. 'msg.sender' always refers to the immediate caller and cannot be spoofed by an intermediate contract.
